decision.best_valid_partial_closure: Public global annual yield observations (GDHY, 1981-2016) plus paired historical-climate crop-model simulations (ISIMIP2a/GGCMI, 1980-2012) provide out-of-period skill and interannual/water-mode diagnostics across EU5 super-regions.

sources.title: Global dataset of historical yields v1.2 and v1.3 aligned version
sources.creator: Iizumi, Toshichika; Sakai, T

source_semantics.estimate_type: 0.5-degree grid-cell yield estimates using satellite crop-specific vegetation indices aligned to FAO country yield statistics
source_semantics.area_definition: time-constant harvested-area distribution from 2000 used by source authors
source_semantics.missingness: many missing values in first/last years and grid cells without estimated harvested crop
source_semantics.absolute_unit_conversion: t ha-1 x 1000 = kg ha-1 is a unit conversion only; no 1337 yield conversion or technology adjustment is applied

mapping.method: nearest GDHY 0.5-degree grid center from calibrated EU5 location centroid; summaries weighted by calibrated area_km2
mapping.coverage_warning: GDHY cells without crop-estimated yield remain missing and are never filled; coverage fractions are explicitly reported. Ocean super-region has no valid crop rows.

skill_and_uncertainty_conversion.relative_anomaly_definition: For each crop, super-region and year with valid area, r = area_weighted_yield_year / median(area_weighted_yield over valid years).
skill_and_uncertainty_conversion.parameter_use: Use relative anomaly and variance only to test interannual-risk tails and spatial covariance; retain the mechanistic 1337 yield level as the sole capacity source.
skill_and_uncertainty_conversion.minimum_coverage_policy: A diagnostic row with low valid_area_fraction is reported but cannot calibrate a global parameter or be imputed from another region.
skill_and_uncertainty_conversion.source_independence: Independent of historical manorial/documentary sources, but not an independent 1337 population observation.

cross_source_skill_audit.comparison: Paired modern rice anomaly correlations and standardized RMSE by five land super-regions plus the explicit zero-coverage Atlantic group, for rain-fed and full-irrigation ISIMIP modes.
cross_source_skill_audit.interpretation: Modern skill diagnostic only. It does not calibrate 1337 absolute yields, replace missing historical labels, or supply population targets.

sources.title: ISIMIP2a Simulation Data from the Agriculture Sector: CLM-Crop WATCH WFDEI historical rice
sources.citation: Müller et al. (2023), ISIMIP2a Simulation Data from the Agriculture Sector (v2.0)

source_semantics.estimate_type: CLM-Crop model output driven by WFDEI historical climate under GGCMI/ISIMIP2a protocol
source_semantics.water_mode_semantics: separate no-irrigation and full-irrigation model runs; never treated as observed irrigation fractions
source_semantics.time_coordinate_note: NetCDF time is encoded as years since 1980 with a proleptic Gregorian calendar; values are indexed deterministically as 1980-2012 without converting to dates

mapping.method: nearest CLM-Crop 0.5-degree grid center from calibrated EU5 location centroid; summaries weighted by calibrated area_km2
mapping.coverage_warning: Model output is available across nearly all land cells but does not represent historical cultivated area or 1337 management; it is not a capacity label.

skill_and_uncertainty_conversion.water_mode_contrast: delta_rice = full_irrigation_yield - rainfed_yield at the same grid cell and year; only paired finite cells are included.
skill_and_uncertainty_conversion.model_disagreement_policy: ISIMIP model output is not averaged with GDHY; disagreement is retained as an uncertainty/skill diagnostic.
skill_and_uncertainty_conversion.forbidden_conversion: Do not convert modeled modern rice yields into 1337 yields, population targets or irrigation acreage.

global_closure.unresolved_gap: No public, machine-readable global annual yield observation series covering 1100-1500 and mappable historical boundaries was found. GDHY/ISIMIP close modern model-skill diagnostics only; they must not be promoted to 1337 labels.
global_closure.accepted_use: Use these artifacts in grouped super-region risk validation and uncertainty ablations after the mechanistic 1337 model is fit from physical sources and vetted historical aggregate anchors.
